title: Sample Where You Struggle: Sharpening Base Model Reasoning via Entropy-Guided Power Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2606.09926v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sampling from the sequence-level power distribution elicits RL-level reasoning from base language models without any parameter updates, but the standard Metropolis--Hastings (MH), a Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampler, is both expensive and slow-mixing. We trace both to a structural mismatch: the power distribution mainly departs from the base distribution at a sparse, spatially clustered set of high-entropy decision points, yet MH proposes resampling positions uniformly along the prefix---wasting compute on near-degenerate conditionals while under-mixing precisely where modes diverge. We propose Entropy-Guided Power Sampling (EGPS), a training-free and verifier-free approximate sampler that re-derives its proposal from token-level entropy already in the forward pass. EGPS skips deterministic blocks, localizes each MCMC move to a high-entropy neighborhood, and applies Multiple-Try Metropolis at decision points---making samp

translated_title: 在你困惑之处采样：通过熵引导的幂采样锐化基础模型推理能力
translated_abstract: 从序列级幂分布中进行采样，能够在不更新任何参数的情况下，使基础语言模型展现出强化学习级别的推理能力，但标准的Metropolis--Hastings（MH）采样器（一种马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样器）既昂贵又混合缓慢。我们将这两个问题归因于一种结构性失配：幂分布主要在一个稀疏且空间聚集的高熵决策点集合处偏离基础分布，而MH却在整条前缀上均匀地提出重采样位置——在近乎退化的条件分布上浪费计算，却在众数真正分歧之处混合不足。我们提出了熵引导幂采样（EGPS），这是一种无需训练、无需验证器的近似采样器，它利用前向传播中已有的token级熵来重新推导其提议分布。EGPS跳过确定性片段，将每次MCMC移动定位到高熵邻域，并在决策点处应用多试Metropolis——使采样……
tldr: 提出熵引导幂采样（EGPS），利用前向传播中已有的token级熵将MCMC移动聚焦到高熵决策点，以无需训练、无需验证器的方式高效提升基础模型从幂分布采样带来的强化学习级推理能力。
en_tdlr: EGPS is a training-free, verifier-free entropy-guided MCMC sampler that localizes sampling moves to high-entropy decision points, enabling base models to efficiently achieve RL-level reasoning via power-distribution sampling.
